name: ZX_QUICK_RULE_RESULTS_F
description: This table contains tax rules that are defined to evaluate the rule results based on the tax determinants for quick rule processing.

columns.name: QUICK_RULE_RESULT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the quick rule record.

columns.name: RULE_TEMPLATE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the template used to populate the rule conditions.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Groups the application event classes that are essentially the same from a tax perspective such as receivables invoice, on-account credit memo, etc.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class code associated with the tax rule.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code associated with the tax rule.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code associated with the tax rule.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority in which this tax rule is evaluated for the tax determination process.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the tax rule is enabled for processing. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the configuration owner of this tax rule.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded, or defined by the user.

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of rule used for processing. Valid values: DET_TAXABLE_ VALUE_ ADDITION, DET_PER_UNIT_THRESHOLD, DET_TAXABLE_BASIS, and DET_DIRECT_RATE. DET_TAXABLE_ VALUE_ ADDITION means the rule is used to determine the taxable amount value additions. DET_PER_UNIT_THRESHOLD means the rule is used to determine the unit price threshold, DET_TAXABLE_BASIS means the rule is used to determine the taxable basis. DET_DIRECT_RATE means the rule is used to determine the tax rate.

columns.name: MIN_THRESHOLD_VALUE
columns.description: Minimum threshold value associated with the tax rule.

columns.name: MAX_THRESHOLD_VALUE
columns.description: Maximum threshold value associated with the tax rule.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE_THRESHOLD_TYPE
columns.description: Unit price level threshold type. Valid values: NULL, MIN_MAX, MIN_MAX_ENFMIN, FIXED_PRICE. MIN_MAX means the minimum or maximum threshold is applicable on the unit price threshold rule. MIN_MAX_ENFMIN means the minimum or maximum threshold is applicable on the unit price threshold rule, and the minimum threshold will be enforced if defined. FIXED_PRICE means the specified fixed price is applicable on the unit price threshold rule.

columns.name: RECOVERY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the recovery type for the tax of this tax rule. Only applicable for the recovery rate determination rule.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code. Only applicable for tax rate determination rule.

columns.name: NUMERIC_RESULT
columns.description: Numeric value of the result from the tax determination process.

columns.name: ALPHANUMERIC_RESULT
